name: Tsuya Jewellers
description: Tsuya Jewellers — a WooCommerce store theme for an independent jeweller. A pale grey-violet ground (#DFDDE2) with ink plum (#2A2433) and one brass accent used only on type. The home page opens on a framed low-key photograph with a flat caption strip below and a split header that slides in after the first screen; it continues with an offset photo pair, flat 3:4 product tiles with one thin arrow, an offset commission strip with the next photograph peeking in, run-in process paragraphs, a full-bleed bench band, the people who finish the work, a prices band and the visit. Instrument Sans for headings, Manrope for reading. Sample content and products in English; works without WooCommerce. Slow parallax and quiet scroll reveals; WCAG AA colours.
